formula: const networkRisk = networkType === 'public-open' ? 40 : networkType === 'public-password' ? 30 : networkType === 'hotel-business' ? 25 : networkType === 'home-secured' ? 5 : 10; const vpnRisk = vpnUsage === 'never' ? 25 : vpnUsage === 'rarely' ? 20 : vpnUsage === 'sometimes' ? 10 : 0; const activityRisk = activitiesRisk === 'very-high' ? 20 : activitiesRisk === 'high' ? 15 : activitiesRisk === 'medium' ? 10 : 5; const browserRisk = browserSecurity === 'poor' ? 15 : browserSecurity === 'basic' ? 10 : browserSecurity === 'good' ? 5 : 0; const deviceRisk = deviceSecurity === 'poor' ? 15 : deviceSecurity === 'basic' ? 10 : deviceSecurity === 'good' ? 5 : 0; const fileSharingRisk = fileSharing ? 10 : 0; const autoConnectRisk = autoConnect ? 8 : 0; const riskScore = Math.min(100, networkRisk + vpnRisk + activityRisk + browserRisk + deviceRisk + fileSharingRisk + autoConnectRisk); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'Very High Risk' : riskScore >= 50 ? 'High Risk' : riskScore >= 30 ? 'Medium Risk' : riskScore >= 15 ? 'Low Risk' : 'Very Low Risk'; const vulnerabilities = [vpnUsage === 'never', browserSecurity === 'poor' || browserSecurity === 'basic', deviceSecurity === 'poor' || deviceSecurity === 'basic', fileSharing, autoConnect, networkType === 'public-open'].filter(Boolean).length; const topRecommendation = vpnUsage === 'never' ? 'Use a VPN on public networks' : browserSecurity === 'poor' ? 'Upgrade to a privacy-focused browser like Incognito Browser' : deviceSecurity === 'poor' ? 'Update your device security settings' : fileSharing ? 'Disable file sharing on public networks' : 'Review your Wi-Fi auto-connect settings'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, vulnerabilityCount: vulnerabilities, recommendationPriority: topRecommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your Wi-Fi security risk based on network type, protective measures (VPN, browser security), device configuration, and online activities. The risk score combines factors like encryption level, data sensitivity, and security practices to provide an overall vulnerability assessment.
tips: Always use a VPN when connecting to public Wi-Fi networks to encrypt your internet traffic
Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser that block tracking and enhance security
Disable auto-connect to Wi-Fi networks to prevent connecting to malicious hotspots
Turn off file sharing and AirDrop when on public networks
Avoid accessing sensitive information like banking on unsecured public Wi-Fi
Verify network names with staff - hackers often create fake hotspots with similar names
Keep your device's operating system and security software updated
Use HTTPS websites only (look for the lock icon in your browser)
